summary: V3-005B (PR #82, head 2f5f16ab, base v3/develop) is complete, Codex-reviewed and CI-green, but its pre-registered qualification records two scientific failures and one inconclusive result: V5 absolute IDD vs TOPAS fails on peak/plateau (+12.5 % / +12.3 %) and the plateau-integrated nuclear on-off difference (−18.5 % / −14.7 %), pre-attributed to the hadronic elastic channel that ionmc does not yet have (D2, deferred to V3-005C by Amendment 7); V7 replicate coverage fails the pre-registered paired gate on the escaped-neutral scalar (0.6586, exact lower bound 0.6445 against 0.6464; the two other estimators pass both gates); the python-vs-warp nuclear_local profile parity is inconclusive by the frozen sparse-profile rule. EXPERIMENT.md requires that "relevant validation must pass" before integration into develop; plan Amendment 11 (frozen before the observation) requires that a failed V7 re-run be recorded as a scientific failure without a further base and handed to V3-005C; the protocol requires failed attempts to be preserved. The two readings of "relevant validation" are materially incompatible for a task whose implementation validation passes but whose scientific acceptance rows fail, and the repository documentation does not say which applies. The validation-manager merge gate refuses the merge with the (truthful) failed records, so the orchestrator cannot resolve this by itself.

investigation.blocked_claim: Integration of task V3-005B (PR #82, head 2f5f16abaf57ab9dbce3163cad1ff2d8d7ace4ad) into v3/develop: whether a task whose implementation validation passes but whose pre-registered scientific acceptance rows (V5, V7 replicate coverage) fail and are recorded per the frozen plan may be merged under EXPERIMENT.md 'relevant validation must pass'. No scientific claim is blocked; the ledger already records V1-MUST-005/013 independent-MC and V2-NUM uncertainty-coverage evidence as not established.
investigation.budget: Spent on V3-005B: 30 task-branch commits, 22 Codex review rounds, two full lv5b qualification chains at bases 20441004 (consumed) and 20471004 plus hr5 (32 host-runner steps, about 7 h of single-process host time at the final SHA), one SIGSEGV root-cause fix. Remaining for this question: none needed; the decision is a protocol interpretation. V3-005C planning continues without repository integration until the answer arrives.
alternatives: Record an additional passing 'integration-gate' validation limited to the implementation checks so that merge_task_pull_request accepts the merge — not done without authorisation, because the plan rows that fail are part of the task's declared validation and recording a passing gate could be read as circumventing the truthful failed records.

Re-scope or re-run the failed rows (further seed base, larger samples, relaxed tolerances) — forbidden: Amendment 11 fixes 'no further base' for V7 before the observation, and tolerances are frozen; a post-hoc amendment after observation is excluded by the plan.

Keep the branch unmerged and continue V3-005C on top of it — possible, but it stacks the elastic-channel work (new decision rows, V6 measured data) onto an unmerged 30-commit branch and delays integration of reviewed kernel code; the choice between this and merging is the operator's.

Wait for V3-005C to make V5/V7 pass and merge both together — same as the previous alternative with a longer horizon; V5 may still fail after elastic scattering (X1-X4 show elastic explains most, not all, of the peak deficit).

reason_autonomous_resolution_not_possibl: Interpretation A: the relevant validation for integrating the Warp nuclear kernels into develop is the implementation validation (sandbox pytest 810 passed at the head, VAL-20261009-032543-E47A52; CI run 37878590336 success, VAL-20261009-032548-17B65D; Codex REVIEW-87590762dcfd4dacb808a4c64fcf529b pass; V8 trajectory parity 1e-10, R1/A16 bit-identical regression, V2b, V7 scan/shift, V7 f32/f64 and all CPU/CUDA statistical-parity pairs pass), while the failed scientific rows are ledger facts (V1-MUST-005/013 independent-MC evidence and V2-NUM uncertainty-coverage evidence not established) carried into V3-005C; develop is not the release branch, and qualification/promotion to v3/main stays gated. Interpretation B: any failed acceptance row of a task's qualification suite blocks integration; the branch stays unmerged until V3-005C (elastic channel D2, V5/V6 re-run on a fresh base, pre-registered V7 re-test) makes the rows pass on top of this branch, or the rows are re-scoped — which would be a post-hoc amendment after observation and is forbidden by the plan. Scientific uncertainty is not the reason for this request; the integration rule is. Records: lv5b VAL-20261009-031623-77E7C6 (failed), hr5 VAL-20261009-031638-326695 (failed), pytest-sandbox and ci (passed), all keyed to 2f5f16ab; archives validation/results/transport/lv5b-7aae5bb-single-process.json and hr5-7aae5bb-single-process.json; narrative in validation/results/transport/README.md and decisions/0041 slice-B outcome.
requested_input: One of: (1) "Merge under interpretation A": authorise merging PR #82 at head 2f5f16ab with the failed lv5b/hr5 records preserved. State whether the operator merges it or whether the orchestrator may record an additional passing "integration-gate" validation limited to the implementation validation (pytest, CI, Codex, parity/regression rows) so that merge_task_pull_request accepts the merge; the scientific records stay failed in either case. (2) "Keep unmerged under interpretation B": V3-005C continues on top of this task branch and PR #82 is merged only after V5 and V7 pass. (3) Any other instruction, e.g. a general rule for tasks whose pre-registered scientific rows fail, to be recorded in EXPERIMENT.md or AGENTS.md by a follow-up task. Decisions that depend on the answer: whether V3-005C (D2 p-p and p-nucleus elastic, V6 Gottschalk, V5/V6 re-run on a fresh base, pre-registered V7 re-test, larger python sample for the nuclear_local parity) branches from v3/develop or from task/v3-005b; the ledger status wording for V1-MUST-005/013 and V2-NUM. Planning of V3-005C (research and plan drafting, no repository integration) continues meanwhile.
